newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada March new motor vehicle sales rise 8.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: Canada March new motor vehicle sales rise 8.5 pct.

text.p: New motor vehicle sales rose 8.5 percent seasonally adjusted in March to 121,715 units from a revised 112,204 (111,377) units in February, Statistics Canada said on Tuesday.
A Reuters survey of economists had forecast a 4.7 percent rise in March.
Statistics Canada said the increase was driven by the largest monthly gain in passenger car sales since March 1993, a rise of 12.3 percent.
Industry sources have suggested that the high sales pace of new motor vehicles would show a continuation in April, StatsCan said.
